title: ย่ามะลิ
statusNotes: Rigged and animated GLB, shown in #/showcase only. Not placed in any scene yet and not editable in #/editor (skinned mesh). No entity in the room data yet; the id is new.
dimensionsNotes: Bind pose (A-pose), so the width is the arm span. Origin at the floor between the feet, facing +Z (glTF / Three.js), metres in the GLB.

source.notes: Cut out with rembg (ref/cut.py), cropped to the figure and padded to a 1224 x 1224 transparent square.

generator.license: Generated on a Meshy Pro plan: the output may be used commercially (Meshy terms for paid plans).

SitDown.notes: Walks ~0.9 m forward, turns 90 degrees and sits facing +X; ends at the seat anchor.

SitIdle.notes: Trimmed to 0-3.7 s (upright part; the original slumps from ~4 s), last 0.6 s blended back to frame 0, rotated +90 degrees and moved onto the seat anchor.

SitTalk.notes: Rotated +90 degrees and moved onto the seat anchor. Knees are wide, so the skirt spreads.

Walk.notes: In place. The skirt splits into two legs (the skin follows the thigh bones).

droppedClips.Run: Free running clip from rigging: does not suit an elderly character and would add ~100 KB.

seat.notes: Model space, metres. Where a seat must be for SitDown / SitIdle / SitTalk.

notes: The skirt is part of the single skinned mesh, so in Walk it splits like trousers. A cloth bone or a skirt-specific rig would be needed to fix it.
Hands are mittens: the Meshy rig has no finger bones (24 joints).
Facial expression is baked into the texture; there are no blend shapes.
Large raw Meshy downloads (~4.5 MB each) are not in git: meshy/raw/ is git-ignored and Meshy only keeps task results for 3 days.
